corrections.defect_1_label: C1 labelled two Beijing wall-clock readings as UTC: "test_capture_started_utc 2026-10-25T00:30:27Z" and "desktop_capture_started_utc 2026-10-25T00:30:51Z". Those are +08:00 readings.
corrections.correct_equivalence: 2026-10-24T16:30:27Z = 2026-10-25T00:30:27+08:00 and 2026-10-24T16:30:51Z = 2026-10-25T00:30:51+08:00. The two clock readings are the same instants, only the zone labels were wrong.
corrections.defect_2_scope: C1 turned retained file existence times into a claim about when a checker executed, and its ORDER_STATUS wording (PRE_TEST_ORDERING_PROVEN_FOR_STAGING) could still be read as ordering of the first checker run.
corrections.corrected_scope: retained file times support that the staged files existed before the tests ran. They do not show that the pin checker executed at any particular moment.
corrections.unaffected: the factor comparison driver re-verifies package hashes inside its own run, so that output stays valid within its own measured scope regardless of this reporting issue
